# IUILE Watercolors

> > IUILE creates handmade metallic and color-shift watercolor paints in innovative formats for professional and amateur artists.

IUILE specializes in artisanal watercolor paints featuring shimmer, metallic, holographic, and color-shift effects. The product line includes multiple formats (half pans, quarter pans, buttons, dot cards) organized into themed collections ranging from seasonal releases to signature series like Magical Drop, Pearl, and Fairy Color Shift.

## Key Topics

- Handmade watercolor paints
- Color-shift effects
- Shimmer metallic paints
- Magical Drop collection
- Holographic watercolors
- Chrome mica
- Fairy Color Shift Series
- Pearl Series
- Neon paints
- Sampler sets
- Half pan sets
- Quarter pan sets
- Button format paints
- Seasonal collections
- Aurora shimmer
